# Is your S3 bucket in the wrong storage class?

> Paste per-bucket S3 size, object count and read activity and see the monthly cost in Standard, Standard-IA, Intelligent-Tiering and Glacier Instant Retrieval, with the small-object and minimum-duration traps. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
